questions.q: Which action is part of deprovisioning an account?
options: Keep active sessions to avoid disrupting the user
Revoke active sessions and tokens and transfer asset ownership
questions.explain: Revocation must be complete and immediate; audit logs are retained as evidence.

questions.q: Match each model or protocol to its definition.

pairs.right: Rights attached to a role inherited by the user
Labels and central policy enforce the decision
Signed assertion between identity provider and service

questions.explain: Roles, owner, labels, federated authentication, and delegated authorization are five distinct concepts. SAML and OAuth are from objective 4.5 (beyond textbooks).

questions.q: Which combinations truly constitute MFA? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: MFA requires two different factor categories: something you know, have, or are. Two memorized secrets are not enough.

questions.q: An administrator needs production access for two hours. Which model is most appropriate?
options: Just-in-time access with approval and expiration
questions.explain: JIT limits the exposure window to the required time and automatically revokes access.

questions.q: Which statement about passkeys is correct?
options: The secret is sent to each site that uses it
The cryptographic key stays on the device and the site receives a signature
It is a longer password stored on the server
It is a type of hardware token that must be physical
questions.explain: Passkeys rely on a key pair: the private key never leaves the device, making them phishing-resistant. Concept from objective 4.5 (beyond textbooks).

questions.q: Which practice should be avoided according to updated exam guidance?
questions.explain: Mandatory 30-day rotation is an outdated textbook recommendation: NIST SP 800-63B prioritizes length, breach checks, and MFA.
